lead_raw_text:
The structure of NdDy6Si2 crystallizes in the trigonal space group R-3 (No. 143), with 36 atoms per unit cell (Nd3 Dy18 Si6) distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Dy centers with 12 geometric neighbors in a close-packed-like local arrangement, while Nd centers show 16 neighbors (4 Dy, 12 Si) and Si centers have 9 neighbors (3 Dy, 6 Nd). The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 36 sites. Validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner, edge, and face sharing among Dy, Nd, and Si coordination polyhedra.
